items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I still have a huge score, I thought I found it last night, but that wasn't it, the last thing I'd written for him, but I never got to him.

ctx.x: Did Kenton ask you to write for him?
Yeah. I still have a huge score, I thought I found it last night, but that wasn't it, the last thing I'd written for him, but I never got to him.
